meta.title: Valby Skakklub — chess in Valby since 1935
meta.description: Valby Skakklub meets every Thursday from 17.30 at Høffdingsvej 10 in Valby, Copenhagen. Free teaching for juniors, beginners, women and girls. No signup, and visitors pay nothing.

nav.brandHome: Valby Skakklub, back to the home page

home.headline: Every Thursday from 17.30
home.lede: Free teaching. No signup. Everyone is welcome.

events.heading: Coming up at the club
events.empty: Nothing extra is scheduled right now. Club night runs every Thursday as always.

join.heading: Become a member
join.note: Visitors pay nothing. Come as many Thursdays as you like before you join.

footer.payment: Membership dues and tournament entry fees are paid by bank transfer to the club's Nordea account.

calendarPage.title: Calendar
calendarPage.description: Upcoming club nights and events at Valby Skakklub.
calendarPage.heading: Calendar
calendarPage.intro: Club night is every Thursday from 17.30. Listed below are the events that go beyond the standing evening.

tournamentsPage.title: Tournaments
tournamentsPage.description: Rated tournaments, blitz and the club championship at Valby Skakklub.
tournamentsPage.heading: Tournaments
tournamentsPage.intro: The club's tournaments are rated under the Danish Chess Union and played on club night.
tournamentsPage.emtBody: Swiss system over seven rounds on consecutive Thursdays, 90 minutes plus 30 seconds per move. Entry 150 kr.
tournamentsPage.blitzBody: Fast games on a single evening, three games of ten minutes each. The junior series is free, with prizes of 150, 100 and 50 kr.
tournamentsPage.registerNote: Tournament registration opens once the tournament pages are ready. Entry fees are paid by bank transfer.

galleryPage.title: Gallery
galleryPage.heading: Gallery
galleryPage.empty: There are no pictures here yet. Come by on a Thursday and there will be something to show.

contactPage.title: Contact
contactPage.description: Get in touch with the committee at Valby Skakklub.
contactPage.heading: Contact
contactPage.intro: You do not need to write ahead to visit — just turn up on a Thursday. If you have a question, we are here.
